title: SpendBudget
description: A spend budget for one domain and period (PRP-44; evaluated against the cost ledger by PRP-46). Titled SpendBudget because query/v1 already exports a Budget (the query execution budget). amount is a decimal string in currency, never a float. thresholds_percent are alert points as integer percentages of amount (strictly ascending, so 50, 80, 100, 120). tags_filter narrows the budget to CostRecord rows whose tags contain every listed key and value; absent means every row of the domain. Rules JSON Schema cannot express (thresholds strictly ascending) are checked by tests/contracts/validators.py::check_budget_thresholds_ascending.

tags_filter.description: Absent means every cost row of the domain.
